visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and bangs, wearing a light beige button-up shirt, stands before a plain white wall. She addresses the camera directly, using a finger-pointing gesture and then showing four fingers to represent her list. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. (2) She introduces a black leather saddle bag from the brand Beara Beara. She holds it close to the lens to show the smooth, stiff texture of the leather and taps it with her fingers. (3) The scene shifts to showing a square box-style leather bag. She displays the interior, which is densely packed with a phone, wallet, and other small items. A cutaway shot shows her outdoors on a sidewalk, wearing a long brown coat and modeling the bag over her shoulder. (4) She holds a large, slouchy black leather tote bag from the brand Aeta. She hugs the bag to demonstrate its extreme softness and flexibility against her shirt. A screen overlay appears showing an Instagram post of a cylindrical bag. (5) She presents a small baby-pink leather bag and a red leather wallet from Hender Scheme. She is now wearing a black and brown geometric patterned sweater. She points out the glossy surface of the pink bag. (6) She introduces a grey-taupe leather shoulder bag from REN. She opens the top to show the spacious interior and squeezes the leather to emphasize its lightweight quality before looking back at the camera with a confident expression.
